disposition_reason: ICP-MS zirconium detections (near LOD, all below LOQ) in brush cytology samples of oral mucosa around zirconia implants; human biological matrix.

period.as_reported: October 2017 to November 2019 (phases in October 2017, February 2018, November 2019)

study.method: micro-brush cytology, acid digestion at 80 °C, Agilent 7700x ICP-MS with He collision cell
lod: LOQ stated as 0.5 to 1 µg/L (Methods) and 2 ppb (Phase II results)
study.qa: Spiked micro-brush QC recoveries 86 to 87% for Zr; triplicate instrumental readings

material.label_as_printed: Peri-implant mucosa cytology sample, zirconia implant subject Z1
material.form: cytologic brush sample in acid matrix solution

findings.group: Phase I zirconia implant group (5 subjects), Geneva
findings.notes: Semi-quantitative ICP-MS; LOD 0.07 µg/L for Zr-90 [He]; concentration is in the prepared sample solution, not per tissue mass.

findings.group: Phase II zirconia implant group (7 subjects) after controlled titanium dioxide intake
findings.reported: 0.07 and 0.15 ppb at two implant sites; 0.12 ppb at one contralateral tooth; all others below LOD; all below the stated LOQ of 2 ppb
findings.locator: Results Phase II and Table 2c, p. 4720
findings.notes: Quantitative mode. The methods state LOQ 0.5 or 1 µg/L for zirconium isotopes while the Phase II text states 2 ppb.

non_numeric_findings: Zirconium was not quantifiable in any subject once food and toothpaste intake were controlled (Conclusions).
